title: Cut
description: A role's part of the design tree, at .rn/<run>/rounds/<n>/<role>[-<group>].cut.json, so that the role starts with only the decisions its work needs.

role.description: The role that the Cut starts.

deliverable.description: The deliverable's name, path, kind, and more_paths where it has them, as the design tree holds them.

more_paths.description: Each other file or folder the deliverable is made of, a folder closing with `/`.

best_practice.description: The folder of the best practice the Round works by: the kind's in a Round of content, refactor-doc or refactor-code in a Round of refactoring.

goal.description: The goal of the design tree, with the state its people are in once it holds.

decisions.description: For the generator: each decision of the deliverable's node and of each input node with no file, by its node's path and condition, with who settled it where it's settled.

group.description: For an evaluator: the ID of the group of the best practice's conditions that it judges, such as C1.

conditions.description: For an evaluator: the ID of each condition of its group that the Round judges.
